selection_filter.requires: known discovery date, latitude/longitude, MTBS ID

crosswalk.matching_rule: One unique FEDS fire whose t_st date is within -1/+2 days of the FPA-FOD discovery date and whose perimeter lies within the fixed 3 km radius during the first 24 hours after t_st. Each retained episode has five consecutive 12-hour FEDS states from its initial observed state through +48 hours.

deduplication.rule: ADR-030 §6: one record per FEDS fire (fireID and start time); when several FPA-FOD records join the same FEDS fire, keep the one with the lowest fod_id.

agent_inputs: initial FEDS perimeter and active-front state
LANDFIRE fuels and terrain for the episode map
standardized resource budget and current simulator state
evaluation_only: future FEDS state timestamps and geometries

limitations: The FPA-FOD discovery point is an incident reference point with unknown case-specific positional uncertainty, not a verified ignition coordinate.
The candidate frame is restricted to screened >=5,000-acre incidents in ten western states and is not a representative national sample.
FEDS perimeters are satellite-derived 375 m observations and are noisy references, not ground-truth fire boundaries.
FLE outcomes are not included in this episode manifest and cannot identify counterfactual line effectiveness.

pre_agent_data_gate.instruction: Stop before agent training if false; a split-only audit is incomplete; do not replace the cohort silently.
